pages.text: Home - The Cafe Seasonal dishes. Familiar faces. Hours MONDAY - SATURDAY Breakfast 7am - 10:30am Lunch 11am - 4pm Dinner 4pm - 9pm SUNDAY Brunch 7am - 2pm Menus Breakfast Brunch Lunch & Dinner Deli Dessert Cocktails Welcome to The Café A dining experience shaped by the people who gather here and the food we love to create Guided by the season, our rotating breakfast, lunch, and dinner menus reflect what’s fresh and in season, turning familiar flavors into dishes that feel both comforting and inspired. Whether you’re swinging through our cafe for a coffee and fresh-baked pastry, or cozied up to our bartop for dinner and handcrafted cocktails, we’re glad to be a place you can return to again and again. Hiring Sous Chef The Café is looking for a dedicated and experienced Sous Chef to join our kitchen team. The ideal candidate brings a strong background in scratch-cooking, exceptional organizational skills, and a true passion for creating memorable dining experiences. If you thrive in a dynamic, high-volume environment and want to help shape our menu and culture, we want to hear from you. To apply, please stop by the restaurant or send your resume and a brief introduction to our team Apply Fresh-baked Bread Available Daily! Please call (515-292-0100) for today’s availability. We request 48 hours notice for all pre-orders. Daily Ciabatta Sourdough Raisin Walnut Baguette Tuesday: Cranberry Pecan Wednesday: Multigrain Thursday: Honey Oat, Focaccia Friday: Challah Saturday: Multigrain Work With Us Passionate people are the foundation of our business. We welcome a variety of skill sets and work experiences and are always looking for those who enjoy challenge and seek growth. Open Interviews: Monday – Thursday 2–4pm Email Your Cart No products in the cart.
